EDS III is hypermobility, basically your skin and bones aren't great at the whole holding your body together deal and you dislocate joints or skin tear easily. POTS is when you get heart rushes without blood rushes when you stand suddenly, implying that blood flow to the brain is insufficient and is related to blood pressure issues basically your heart beats a lot faster to try to get the blood up to your brain but you don't see the associated effect on your blood pressure, LPR is basically GERD but the vomit gets up into where your stomach and airway connect and causes breathing issues (in fact, you would normally just say you had LPR, GERD is implied unless you have a portal somewhere in your esophageal tract). CAWP - chronic abdominal wall pain. Aside from the EDS-III these are all weight/diet related/managed.
